items.title: Minister Muhate wants to see approved investments implemented
items.summary: Mozambique’s Minister of Economy Basílio Muhate wants approved investments not to remain merely on paper. He called for closer monitoring of their implementation to ensure that they are transformed into productive units, jobs, exports and revenue for the State. items.title: PNUD quer reduzir pobreza e criar emprego em Moçambique com novo programa até 2030
